title: C-Suite Qtr Recap and Renewal Worksheet
body:
Purpose:
A compact, C-suite friendly quarterly recap + an editable customer-facing email template plus a one-page renewal worksheet. Designed for a 10-minute executive sync and a short follow-up email to the customer exec sponsor.

How to use this doc:
- Copy the executive summary section into slide 1 of a 1-slide QBR deck for the customer exec.
- Use the customer-facing email template verbatim (or shorten) for distribution after the executive touchpoint.
- Keep the Renewal Worksheet updated weekly; assign a single owner per row.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY (one-slide / 3 bullets + KPI strip)
1) TL;DR (1 sentence):
  - [Customer] continues to scale Redwood inference for production ML features; QoQ token volume +XX% with stable latency and no major incidents; recommend renewal conversation for 2025-08-15.

2) Top outcomes this quarter (3 bullets):
  - Reduced end-to-end inference cost by ~14% via batching + quantization profile rollout on non-critical routes (savings validated by Redwood Optimize).
  - Achieved 99.92% availability for production model endpoints; two short degraded tails during region failover mitigated by automatic fallback.
  - Launched streaming responses for chat flows; reduced perceived latency for key flows by ~240ms.

3) Executive risks & asks (single-line each):
  - Capacity risk: anticipated Q3 peak could exceed Dedicated burst budget — ask: confirm decision on expanding burst pool by +20% (owner: Customer eng lead).
  - Compliance request: upcoming audit requires VPC private deployment timeline — ask: decision on Private deployment pilot by 2025-03-01.
  - Renewal timing: target renewal decision by 2025-06-01 to lock current committed pricing.

KPI STRIP (single line to paste into slide)
  - Monthly token volume: {{tokens_m}} | Avg 95th pct latency: {{latency_ms}} ms | Error rate (4xx/5xx): {{err_rate}}% | Monthly spend: ${{monthly_spend}} | CSAT (NPS-style): {{csat}}

HEALTH INDICATORS (quick read)
  - Usage trends: Steady growth (QoQ +XX%).
  - Latency SLOs: Met for 95% of routes; one bursty route is at risk.
  - Cost: Unit cost down after Optimize changes; caching has ~Y% hit rate.
  - Security/compliance: No open security findings; next audit prep on 2025-02-14.

RISK MITIGATION BRIEFS (1-line mitigations)
  - Peak capacity: temp burst increase + staggered batch windows (short term).
  - Regression risk after model swap: canary rollout + automatic rollback (standard Redwood rollout).
  - Data residency ask: start Private deployment pilot with limited dataset subset.

KEY METRICS (editable placeholders)
  - Prod endpoints: 12
  - Monthly active routes: 8
  - Avg tokens/request: 1,450
  - Token throughput (peak): 120k tokens/s
  - 95th pct latency: 78 ms
  - Error rate (last 30 days): 0.18%
  - Monthly spend: $28,400
  - Cost per 1k tokens: $0.56
  - CSAT (survey): 8.3 / 10

RENEWAL & PROCUREMENT NOTES (short timeline)
  - Renewal target decision window: 2025-05-01 to 2025-06-01
  - Procurement lead: [Customer procurement contact]
  - Commercial ask: commit to 12-month Dedicated capacity + 10% burst buffer to keep current unit pricing.

NEXT STEPS (for internal owner)
  - 48–72h: Share slide + TL;DR with customer exec and confirm exec sync cadence. (owner: CSM)
  - 2 weeks: Capture procurement requirements and draft SOW. (owner: Solutions eng)
  - 4 weeks: Pilot Private deployment scope doc. (owner: Customer eng + Redwood solutions)

CUSTOMER-FACING QUARTERLY RECAP EMAIL (editable)
Subject options:
  - Short: [Company] — Q4 Recap + Next Steps
  - Friendly: Quick recap on your Redwood deployment (Q4)
  - C-suite: Executive recap: production inference performance and renewal window

Email body (recommended length: ~200–350 words):
Hi [Executive First Name],

Quick recap from Redwood on how the platform supported [Customer] this quarter and a couple of recommended next steps.

Highlights:
- Production performance: your endpoints sustained peak traffic at {{peak_tokens_s}} tokens/s with an average 95th-pct latency of {{latency_ms}} ms and overall availability of {{availability}}%.
- Cost optimization: recent batching + quantization changes reduced token unit cost by ~{{pct_cost_reduction}}%. Estimated monthly savings: ${{savings}}.
- Feature rollout: Streaming responses enabled for chat improved perceived response times for users and reduced downstream timeouts.

Risks & actions:
- Capacity: we recommend confirming a +20% burst allocation to avoid throttling during expected promotional traffic spikes.
- Compliance: we are prepared to start a Private deployment pilot if you want to centralize audit logs and KMS-managed keys.

Suggested next steps:
1) Quick 15-minute exec sync to agree on renewal window and capacity decision (proposed dates: [date options]).
2) Procurement touchpoint to capture contract requirements and timeline.
3) Technical review to scope Private pilot if needed.

If helpful I can send a 1-slide QBR before the call. Thanks for continuing to partner with Redwood — excited to support your next phase of scale.

Best,
[CSM name] | Redwood Inference

RENEWAL WORKSHEET (one-line-per-account table; keep in CSM tracker)
Columns: Account | Renewal Date | ARR / MRR | Renewal Owner | Health Score (0-10) | Open Issues | Next Touch (date) | Notes
Example rows (paste into shared tracker):
- Tachyon Media | 2025-06-15 | $420k ARR | Asha Patel | 8 | burst policy + audit prep | 2025-02-20 | procurement aligning PO
- Bluefield Bank | 2025-07-30 | $1.2M ARR | Devon O'Neil | 6 | compliance docs pending | 2025-02-25 | SOW draft outstanding
- Spark Commerce | 2025-05-02 | $95k ARR | Leah Chen | 9 | none | 2025-01-29 | renewal likely

TEMPLATED ACTION MATRIX (for exec slide or internal play)
  - Owner: [name]
  - Action: [short action]
  - Due: [date]
  - Impact: High/Med/Low
  - Status: Not started / In progress / Done

NOTES & SUGGESTED SLIDE LAYOUT
- Left column: TL;DR + one-line ask.
- Middle: KPI strip and 3 outcome bullets.
- Right: Risks + Actions (3x).
- Footer: Renewal window and next touch.

Version history (track edits):
- 2024-11-05: initial draft (Asha Patel)
- 2024-12-12: added KPI strip and renewal worksheet (Marco Ruiz)
- 2025-01-20: clarified asks and added sample email variants (Leah Chen)

END OF DOCUMENT
